title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflow plugins, add dependency-visibility manifest and preflight
author: Derek Huang
description:
Motivation: Our presubmit CI has accumulated several small composite actions and bash scripts for preflight checks (dependency scanning, lint gating, and path-aware test slicing). These scripts are a frequent source of flakes and OS-level differences. This PR consolidates thin workflow plugins into a single lightweight Go-based runner, introduces an explicit dependency-visibility manifest to track declared vs. referenced packages across packages in the monorepo, and adds a preflight job that fails fast when untracked transitive deps are introduced.

Scope of changes: Consolidate the plugin surface (composite actions + bash -> single binary), add tools/dep-visibility (manifest + scanner), tighten CI action pinning for critical steps, and replace the presubmit shell integration with a stable Go CLI used by workflows. This reduces flakiness and speeds up Docker/container-based runner cold starts.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces tools/dep-visibility: manifest schema (tools/dep-visibility/manifest.yaml) and a scanner (tools/dep-visibility/scan.go compiled into dep-visibility-check).
- Replaces scripts/presubmit-checks.sh with small Go runner tools/ci/plugin-runner/main.go that load a plugin manifest and run checks in parallel with bounded concurrency.
- Updates .github/workflows/ci.yml to call the Go runner for preflight, and adds a new preflight lane invoked by pull_request to run fast dependency-visibility checks and path-aware test selection.
- Pins a short list of third-party actions in ci/actions/pinned-action-versions.yml and updates workflow references accordingly to improve hermeticity.
- Adds docs/ci/dependency-visibility.md and README.ci.md describing the manifest format and maintenance process.

Checklist:
- [x] Add dep-visibility manifest and scanner (ENG-2029)
- [x] Migrate presubmit shell logic to Go runner (ENG-2030)
- [x] Pin critical GH Actions used in presubmit lane
- [x] Add CI docs and local run instructions
- [x] Performance verification: preflight cold start latency reduced ~30% in sample runs

Why Go: the presubmit scripts previously depended on bash + multiple utilities (jq, awscli, docker) and behaved differently on macOS vs Linux runners. A small Go binary gives reproducible behavior, easy cross-compilation, and a single dependency surface recorded in go.mod. The binary is intentionally minimal and owned by infra.

Rollback plan: revert the workflow change, restore scripts/presubmit-checks.sh, and re-pin action versions. The Go runner is backwards-compatible with current workflow inputs; we can flip back in under 10 minutes if a regression is observed.

Notes for maintainers: update tools/dep-visibility/manifest.yaml when adding new top-level packages or introducing new language ecosystems. The scanner emits a SARIF-like artifact to aid triage and can be run locally with `make check-dep-visibility`.

Related: ENG-2029 (dep visibility), ENG-2030 (ci plugin consolidation), SUP-7123 (support ticket triggered by flaking presubmit).

release_notes: Consolidated presubmit CI plugins into a single Go runner, added dependency-visibility manifest and preflight check to fail fast on untracked transitive dependencies, and pinned critical GitHub Action versions to reduce CI flakiness. Improves presubmit cold-start time and makes dependency additions explicit.
